'''Scott Latham''' is a Star Wars CCG player whose decks were published on [[Trandosite]], [[Rod Latham]]'s UK fan site.<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls105.htm Flexi-Hidden Base], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228055837/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls105.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
